record_body:
Account summary
- OmniComply building compliance/GRC workflows with LLM summarization + evidence extraction. Primary driver is enterprise customers pushing for auditable operations + predictable spend.
- Interested in Dedicated (primary) with possible move to Private/VPC control plane once initial rollout is stable.

Workload / technical requirements (current)
- Use cases:
  - Evidence/document summarization (long context, batchy)
  - Internal compliance assistant (interactive chat, spiky during business hours)
  - Reranking/embeddings mentioned as phase 2 (not in first POC)
- Performance targets (from calls, somewhat fuzzy):
  - Interactive: p95 < 1.5s to first token preferred; stable throughput during peak review windows
  - Batch summarization: cares more about throughput predictability than single-request latency
- Cost sensitivity: high. Quote from security review call: “We need hard caps so a traffic anomaly can’t turn into an invoice surprise.”

Dedicated autoscaling / auditability (key theme)
- Must have strict min/max bounds per Dedicated pool. Wants max as a hard ceiling for spend control.
- Audit trail requirements (explicit):
  - Config changes: who changed min/max/cooldowns, when, from what -> to what, via UI or API, include request id.
  - Scaling decisions: why did we scale (inputs), desired vs applied replicas, and any clamping due to bounds.
  - Needs export path to their SIEM (Splunk) + retention controls. They specifically asked for 90-day retention minimum and ability to extend to 1 year.
- Concern raised: If max is hit, they want a clear customer-facing warning (“you are capped”) and guidance on expected throttling/latency impact.

Security / compliance notes
- SSO/SAML required for Console access; role separation requested (admin vs read-only auditors).
- KMS: prefers customer-managed keys (cloud KMS acceptable in first phase). Also asked whether audit logs include customer data (should not).
- Data residency: US-only acceptable for pilot; EU availability is a near-term ask due to a subset of their customers.
- Audit: wants “tamper-evident” feel (at minimum immutable event log semantics + export).

Timeline / activity (recent)
- 2026-01-15: Security & compliance review call (Fireflies: ff-2026-01-15-omnicomply-security-audit-review). Main outcome: auditability for scaling/config changes is gating item.
- 2026-01-22: Internal coordination thread on design partner rollout options + what we can commit on audit log availability.
- 2026-02-04: SE follow-up: walked through Dedicated topology + how min/max bounds would behave; customer asked for examples of clamp_reason + where it appears.
- 2026-02-18: Email from OmniComply GRC: asked for “event schema” for scaling decisions, and whether events cover both control plane changes + autoscaler actions.

Current status
- In evaluation; procurement will not start until we can credibly answer audit trail + export + retention questions.
- They are open to being a design partner if we can commit to dates and provide an escalation path.

Open questions to resolve
- Can we provide a written statement on:
  - Scaling/config audit event fields (minimum set)
  - Where events are visible in Console vs API
  - Retention window + export options (webhook/S3/SIEM connector)
- Confirm whether Dedicated bounded autoscaling GA includes:
  - customer-visible scaling history with clamp explanations
  - explicit warnings when max bound is reached (and suggested actions)

Internal notes
- Ownership: Markus Klein (AE/owner). SE: Simran Kaur. CSM looped: Rachel Kim.
- Product contact for feature commitments: Lauren Bishop. For audit log/export: Jada Williams (Console) + Kevin Osei (Security).
- Related internal/support references: SUP-4922 (validation errors & docs clarity), INT-1338 (support macros/escalation checklist).
